name: tabspazio
description: TabSpazio - Apple TV & Google TV style launcher for your browser's New Tab page

scripts.build:chrome: tsc && vite build --outDir dist/chrome && node scripts/postbuild.mjs chrome
scripts.build:firefox: tsc && vite build --outDir dist/firefox && node scripts/postbuild.mjs firefox
scripts.build:chromium: tsc && vite build --outDir dist/chromium && node scripts/postbuild.mjs chromium
scripts.build:edge: tsc && vite build --outDir dist/edge && node scripts/postbuild.mjs edge
scripts.build:opera: tsc && vite build --outDir dist/opera && node scripts/postbuild.mjs opera
scripts.build:all: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox && npm run build:chromium
